questions.q: Who voices Starfire in the animated series Teen Titans and Teen Titans Go!?
questions.why: Hynden Walch has voiced Starfire since 2003.

questions.q: Which actress plays Starfire in the live-action series Titans?
questions.why: Anna Diop plays Starfire in Titans, which ran from 2018 to 2023.

questions.q: What type of radiation does Starfire absorb and turn into energy?
questions.why: She converts ultraviolet light into power for flight, strength and durability.

questions.q: What is the name of Starfire's sister, who seized the throne of her home planet and sold her into slavery?
questions.why: Komand'r, called Blackfire, took the throne and enslaved Koriand'r.

questions.q: Alongside Starfire, Robin and Raven, which hero was a core member of the New Teen Titans?
questions.why: The New Teen Titans lineup was Robin, Wonder Girl, Kid Flash, Cyborg, Changeling, Raven and Starfire.

questions.q: In which comic did Starfire first appear in an October 1980 preview?
questions.why: A preview in DC Comics Presents #26 introduced the new Titans team before their own book launched.

questions.q: What name does Starfire use when working as a model on Earth?

questions.q: Whose experiments gave Starfire her energy 'starbolts'?
questions.why: Psion experiments gave her starbolts that she fires from her hands or eyes.
